delivery.outcome: Decompose the five-state Python comment lexer in packages/koru-scan-todo/src/lib.rs (code2llm CC=38, limit 15) into small per-state helpers: lex_normal (one Normal-state token step returning next state, next index and optional comment range), comment_line_end (comment line scan), push_comment (UTF-8 boundary push), skip_quoted_string (single/double-quoted body with escapes), skip_triple_quoted_string plus is_triple_quote (triple-quoted body) and quote_byte (quote byte for a string state). extract_python_comments keeps the exact public signature and only drives the state-machine loop, so every extracted comment and marker count is byte-identical.
nonGoals: Changing lexer behavior, extracted comment boundaries or marker counts
Changing the public crate API (extract_python_comments signature, count_todo_markers, ScanOptions, DEFAULT_SCAN_EXCLUDES)
Regenerating project/analysis.toon.yaml or other integration-owned discovery artifacts (analysis is regenerated under /tmp only)
Refactoring other lib.rs functions (count_markers_in_text, glob_match, is_koruignored, count_todo_markers_in_project) that are under the CC limit

architecture.decision: Keep the LexState state machine but move each state's branch-heavy transition logic into private helpers so no single function exceeds the CC limit: the public function only advances (state, index) and collects comment ranges. lex_normal returns (next_state, next_index, Option<(start, end)>); quoted-string states consume their body via skip_quoted_string/skip_triple_quoted_string parameterized by the quote byte, with escape handling copied verbatim from the original arms so boundary behavior (backslash at end of input, unterminated strings, newline terminating single-line strings) is unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the single commit to restore the original monolithic lexer loop.

validation.evidence: Rust unit tests (marker counting, string-vs-comment, glob, koruignore) pass unchanged.
Python integration/benchmark tests pass unchanged, proving CLI-level output compatibility.
Regenerated smell scan reports extract_python_comments CC <= 15 and no new complexity smell for the crate. Repository-owned project/ artifacts are not regenerated.
Governance gate passes from the ticket worktree.
